title: Edit brush vertices and faces
summary: Reshape a brush with vertex handles or target an individual face.
outcome: The brush has the intended shape and its changed faces can be inspected and textured.

sections.title: Move a brush point

steps.title: Select the brush
steps.text: Select a whole brush, then activate Edit vertices (E). Projected corner and edge handles appear in grid views.

steps.title: Shape and inspect
steps.text: Drag a visible corner or edge handle in a grid view. Shift-click can toggle handle vertices. Check the other planes and Camera to confirm the depth and face shape; Undo if the result folds or moves the wrong point.

tips: Texture lock keeps mapping attached during ordinary transforms, but some vertex edits cannot preserve every UV. Turn it off if the editor asks, then realign the affected face.

sections.title: Work on one face

steps.title: Target the face
steps.text: Activate Select faces (S), choose a brush face, and use the Surface inspector to review its texture and alignment.

steps.title: Extend to another face
steps.text: With the source brush selected, right-click the target face in Camera and choose Extend selected brush to this face. Its materials and texture projections stay in place.

tips: If the Surface inspector says to select a brush or face, return to Face mode and select the intended surface.
